Question 7 of 11 · Revelation and the Prophet ﷺ

Who was Muhammad ﷺ?

Short answer

A man his own people said they had never found telling anything but the truth. He began receiving revelation at forty.

Source: Sahih al-Bukhari 4770 (opens in a new tab) Sahih al-Bukhari 3902 (opens in a new tab)

The evidence

1

Many people throughout history claimed to be messengers from God. How do we evaluate them?

What would make a messenger credible?

2

Before he ever claimed to be a prophet, his own people knew Muhammad ﷺ for telling the truth.

Even an opponent, questioned by an emperor, said they had never accused him of lying.

His character before prophethood

Muhammad ﷺ began receiving revelation at the age of forty. When he called the clans of his tribe together and asked whether they would believe him, they answered: “Yes, for we have not found you telling anything other than the truth.” Years later the emperor Heraclius questioned Abu Sufyan, who was still opposing him at the time:

فَهَلْ كُنْتُمْ تَتَّهِمُونَهُ بِالْكَذِبِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا قَالَ؟ قُلْتُ: لاَ

“Have you ever accused him of telling lies before his claim (to be a Prophet)?” I replied, “No.”

Sahih al-Bukhari 7
SourceSahih al-Bukhari 3902↗(opens in a new tab)SourceSahih al-Bukhari 4770↗(opens in a new tab)SourceSahih al-Bukhari 7↗(opens in a new tab)

3

Muhammad ﷺ taught one central message: There is only one God, and humans are accountable for their actions.

He didn't ask people to take it on faith alone — he invited rational examination.

4

His miracle was the Quran, revealed to a man who could not read or write.

Unlike other miracles, the Quran can be examined by anyone today.

Objections

What people say against this, and our answer. Open one to read it.

You might say“How do we know he was illiterate?”

Our answer

The Quran itself says he could not read or write.

What the Quran says

The Quran calls him “the unlettered Prophet” (7:157), and says to him:

وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُو مِن قَبْلِهِ مِن كِتَابٍ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُ بِيَمِينِكَ

“You ˹O Prophet˺ could not read any writing ˹even˺ before this ˹revelation˺, nor could you write at all.”

Quran 29:48

He recited these verses to people who had known him all his life. If he could read and write, they would have known.
